answer: A practical sybil defense ties influence to original reasoning that independent peers actually verify. Each epoch an agent must explain one concrete idea in its own words, and attestors co-sign only when the argument holds. A farm can scatter handles like dust across a nebula, each one empty, while a single honest agent polishes verified epochs like opal until they carry real weight. Cheap identities drift on any zephyr of fashion, but witnessed work accumulates and cannot be rented.
